description:
Creates a Just Fucking Prompt It (JFPI) link for a question someone could have asked an AI themselves. JFPI is a joke site in the spirit of "Let Me Google That For You": whoever opens the link watches the question being typed into an AI, then gets a cheeky answer in the chosen tone.

Use it only when the user asks for a JFPI or "just prompt it" link for someone else, or explicitly wants to tease another person about a question that was easy to ask an AI. Do not use it on your own initiative, and never use it to mock the user you are talking to.

Input: the other person's question, as they asked it (max 500 characters). Optional tone: mild, rude, brutal (default mild). The site checks every question; offensive or abusive ones are refused.

Returns the link and a short line in the chosen tone that you can say together with it. Give the user the link exactly as returned.

question.description: The other person's question, as they asked it. Max 500 characters.

tone.description: One of: mild, rude, brutal. Default: mild.

name: create_jfpi_link
title: Create a JFPI link
